description: Check a landlord's notice of a new rent for a periodic standard occupation contract in Wales: whether the new rent starts at least two months after the notice is given, whether it comes at least a year after the last increase, and whether it is on form RHW12; and the earliest the new rent can start. Wales only; it does not judge whether the new rent is fair.

history.description: Whether the rent has gone up before: none, increased (give lastIncrease), or unknown.

lastIncrease.description: If the rent went up before, the day that increase took effect, as YYYY-MM-DD.

prescribedForm.description: Whether the notice is on form RHW12, the Welsh Government form for a notice of variation of rent.

received.description: The day the contract-holder was given the notice, as YYYY-MM-DD.

starts.description: The day the notice says the new rent starts, as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: check_welsh_rent_increase_notice
title: Welsh rent increase check
